pattern: return {o:Obj} to the battlefield under its owner 's control when ~ leaves the battlefield
subject: none

examples.text: Whenever a land enters, if there are three or more other lands on the battlefield, exile that land. Return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control when ~ leaves the battlefield.
Whenever an artifact enters, exile that artifact. Return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control when ~ leaves the battlefield.

counterExamples: Whenever an artifact enters, exile that artifact. Return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control when ~ dies.
Whenever an artifact enters, exile that artifact. Return that card to the battlefield under your control when ~ leaves the battlefield.
Whenever an artifact enters, exile that artifact. Return that card to the battlefield tapped under its owner's control when ~ leaves the battlefield.
